DISASSEMBLY SERVICE POINTS
<<A>> INNER SHAFT REMOVAL
1. Use special tool MB991248 or MD998801 to remove the 
inner shaft assembly and the seal plate from the TJ case.
NOTE: Press the seal plate to deform it, and then press out 
the inner shaft.
2. Use special tool MB991248 or MD998801 to remove the 
inner shaft from the center bearing bracket.
<<B>> CENTER BEARING REMOVAL
Use special tools MB990930 and MB990938 to press the 
center bearing out from the center bearing bracket.
